sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to maintain their excellent run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, but they face visitors Alsager Town who are struggling badly near the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches and a run of five consecutive losses before a recent win.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between mid-table sides, with Stafford chasing leaders Sandbach on 20 points. AFC Bridgnorth, currently third, host Eccleshall in a battle of two of the division's stronger sides—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six despite a recent loss, while Eccleshall sit fifth but have lost their last game. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth) visit Wednesfield Community (ninth) in what should favour the visitors, who are in good form with a recent win. Bilston Town (sixth) travel to Foley Meir (13th) in a fixture between contrasting sides, with Bilston having won their last match. New Mills host Market Drayton Town—both are mid-to-lower table teams with inconsistent records. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in a bottom-half clash, with Crewe winless in their last two and Allscott also struggling. Shawbury United host Barnton; Shawbury are in particularly poor form with five consecutive losses, while Barnton have stabilised with a recent win. Finally, Brereton Social face Widnes Town in what is effectively a basement battle—Widnes are bottom with just 2 points and no wins to date, while Brereton are also in the lower reaches with patchy recent form.
